CustomField.description: Controls how this field's help text is displayed: the standard hover info-icon bubble, as a subtitle directly below the label, or in a line below the input field. Ignored when help text is disabled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose how help text appears: Hover Bubble shows the standard info-icon tooltip, Below Label renders it as a lighter subtitle under the field label, and Below Field shows it directly beneath the input. Has no effect when Disable Help Text is on.
CustomField.label: helpTextDisplay
